title: Order of a self-complementary graph modulo four
statement: Let $G$ be a self-complementary simple graph on a finite vertex set $V$; that is, $G$ is isomorphic to its complement $\overline{G}$. Then the number of vertices $\abs{V}$ satisfies $\abs{V} \equiv 0 \pmod 4$ or $\abs{V} \equiv 1 \pmod 4$.
hypotheses_covered: G is a simple graph on V
existence of a graph isomorphism from G to its complement (self-complementary)
